title: Far-away
tagline: It is a frame that create an AA wallet for any user. It is easy to use fast and nice
description: I combined two different AA provider and made it work in a few clicks. It is easy to use fast and good looking. I think it just works. That is the gist of it . It does what is required of it.This project uses pinata for serving images, vercel serverless, dynamic.xyz embedded wallet, and privy wallet to create an easy to use wallet generator. I also used Dalle to generate the images.
